late.criticalFailure: Half the realm believed an army was coming, and the flight toward the capital turned into riots. The roads are choked with refugees, and some will never come back.

early.criticalSuccess: A neighbor's steward had come to complain about the realm's hunters and wouldn't stop shouting. He was calmly heard out and offered fair bounds for the hunters, and his lord sent a thank-you letter.
early.success: A neighbor's steward had come to complain about the realm's hunters and wouldn't stop shouting. He was calmed down with a fair hearing, and his complaint was settled.
early.failure: A neighbor's steward had come to complain about the realm's hunters. He kept shouting until he left, and nothing was settled.
early.criticalFailure: A neighbor's steward had come to complain about the realm's hunters, and he was shouted back at. His lord is furious.

middle.criticalSuccess: A neighbor's envoy had delivered an ultimatum about trade on the river. It was answered so skilfully that he withdrew it and offered a trade deal instead.
middle.success: A neighbor's envoy had delivered an ultimatum about trade on the river. It was answered firmly but fairly, and the neighbor backed down.
middle.failure: A neighbor's envoy had delivered an ultimatum about river trade. It was answered, but the neighbor is still unhappy.
middle.criticalFailure: A neighbor's envoy had delivered an ultimatum about river trade, and it was rejected rudely. The river is closed to the realm's boats.

late.criticalSuccess: A foreign power had sent heralds to read out its grievances in the capital's square. The realm's answer was so wise and gracious that the crowd cheered, and the foreign power withdrew its complaints.
late.success: A foreign power had sent heralds to read out its grievances in the capital's square. Each grievance was answered calmly, and the foreign power was mollified.
late.failure: A foreign power had sent heralds to read out its grievances in the capital's square. They were answered, but the foreign power still glowers.
late.criticalFailure: A foreign power had sent heralds to read out its grievances in the capital's square, and they were driven out. The foreign power has declared the realm an enemy.

early.criticalSuccess: Lake fisherfolk wanted to trade their catch for salt from downriver. The trade was made, both sides were so pleased it became a regular run, and the lake villages salt their fish for winter at last.
early.success: Lake fisherfolk wanted to trade their catch for salt from downriver. The first barrels of salt came up in exchange for smoked fish, and both sides are happy.
early.failure: Lake fisherfolk wanted to trade their catch for salt. The trade started, but the prices weren't good for either side.
early.criticalFailure: Lake fisherfolk wanted to trade their catch for salt, and the deal fell apart in a quarrel. They're short of salt.

middle.criticalSuccess: Boatwrights had offered to build trading boats for the lakes. The boats carry goods across the water faster than ever, and the lakeside towns are booming.
middle.success: Boatwrights had offered to build trading boats for the lakes. The boats were built and are carrying goods between the lakeside towns.
middle.failure: Boatwrights had offered to build trading boats for the lakes. They were built, but they're slow and leaky.
middle.criticalFailure: Boatwrights had offered to build trading boats for the lakes, and they built them badly. The first one sank.

late.criticalSuccess: Merchants proposed shipping the realm's goods all the way to distant ports. The route was opened, the goods are reaching those ports, and the profits have made the realm rich.
late.success: Merchants proposed shipping the realm's goods all the way to distant ports. The first ships sailed, and the realm is turning a profit on the trade.
late.failure: Merchants proposed shipping the realm's goods to distant ports. The route was opened, but it's costly and slow.
late.criticalFailure: Merchants proposed shipping the realm's goods to distant ports, and pirates took the route and the goods with it.

early.criticalSuccess: A boat had been slipping past the village every night with no lights. It was stopped one night with a hold full of contraband, the smugglers were caught, and their boat was seized.
early.success: A boat had been slipping past the village every night with no lights. It was stopped by a chain across the river, and the smuggling ended.
early.failure: A boat had been slipping past the village every night with no lights. It was spotted, but it got away.
early.criticalFailure: A boat had been slipping past the village every night with no lights, and its smugglers attacked the watch that tried to stop it.

middle.criticalSuccess: Smugglers had a cove on the river and were running goods past the tolls. The cove was found and raided, their goods seized, and the tolls are being paid again.
middle.success: Smugglers had a cove on the river and were running goods past the tolls. The cove was found and shut down, and the tolls are being paid again.
middle.failure: Smugglers had a cove on the river and were running goods past the tolls. It was found, but they moved elsewhere.
middle.criticalFailure: Smugglers had a cove on the river, and the raid on it failed. They're bolder than ever.

late.criticalSuccess: A smuggling ring ran a whole fleet through the realm's waters, with officials in its pay. The fleet was broken and the bought officials caught, and the realm's waters are clean again.
late.success: A smuggling ring ran a whole fleet through the realm's waters, with some officials in its pay. The ring was broken up, and some of the bought officials were caught.
late.failure: A smuggling ring ran a whole fleet through the realm's waters. It was hurt, but it's still running, and some officials are still in its pay.
late.criticalFailure: A smuggling ring ran a whole fleet through the realm's waters, and it proved too strong. Now more officials are in its pay.

early.criticalSuccess: A scholar from a neighboring land wanted to stay a season and learn the realm's customs. She wrote a glowing book about them, and folks from across the region are coming to see for themselves.
early.success: A scholar from a neighboring land wanted to stay a season and learn the realm's customs. She enjoyed her stay and left with fond memories.
early.failure: A scholar from a neighboring land wanted to stay a season and learn the realm's customs, but she left early and unimpressed.
early.criticalFailure: A scholar from a neighboring land wanted to stay a season and learn the realm's customs, but she insulted them instead and was run out of town.

middle.criticalSuccess: A neighbor had offered to trade students between their schools. The exchange was a great success, and the realm's schools are known abroad.
middle.success: A neighbor had offered to trade students between their schools. A dozen students went each way, and both sides learned from it.
middle.failure: A neighbor had offered to trade students between their schools, but the exchange was small and few went.
middle.criticalFailure: A neighbor had offered to trade students between their schools, and the exchange ended when a student was hurt. The neighbor has cut ties.

late.criticalSuccess: Several nations wanted to open permanent embassies in the capital. They opened, and the realm has become a center of diplomacy.
late.success: Several nations wanted to open permanent embassies in the capital. The embassies were opened, and the realm's ties with them are stronger.
late.failure: Several nations wanted to open permanent embassies in the capital. Some opened, but others were turned away.
late.criticalFailure: Several nations wanted to open permanent embassies in the capital, and the plan fell apart. They're offended.

early.criticalSuccess: A peddler had sold a book that gave folks nightmares. Every copy was tracked down and burned in a single bonfire, the bad dreams stopped that very night, and the village slept late for a week.
early.success: A peddler had sold a book that gave folks nightmares. The copies were bought back and burned, and the bad dreams faded over the next few nights.
early.failure: A peddler had sold a book that gave folks nightmares. Most copies were found, but not all, and a few households still wake up screaming.
early.criticalFailure: A peddler had sold a book that gave folks nightmares, and once word got out that the crown wanted it, everyone wanted a copy. The nightmares have spread to the next village.

middle.criticalSuccess: A treatise on forbidden magic was being copied and passed around in secret. The copyists were found and every copy seized, and the scholars tempted by it were quietly set on better paths.
middle.success: A treatise on forbidden magic was being copied and passed around in secret. Most of the copies were tracked down and burned, and the circle that was copying them broke up and went quiet.
middle.failure: A treatise on forbidden magic was being copied in secret. A few copies were seized, but the circle copying it just went deeper underground.
middle.criticalFailure: A treatise on forbidden magic was being copied in secret, and a young scholar tried one of its spells and burned out his own mind. Copies are still passing from hand to hand.

late.criticalSuccess: A grimoire of terrible power had surfaced, and several factions wanted it. It was taken from under all their noses and sealed where none will find it. The rivals are furious, and the realm is safe.
late.success: A grimoire of terrible power had surfaced, and several factions wanted it. It was seized before any of them could use it, and it sits in a locked vault under heavy guard.
late.failure: A grimoire of terrible power had surfaced, and several factions wanted it. It was recovered, but not before one faction copied pages from it.
late.criticalFailure: A grimoire of terrible power had surfaced, and one of the factions got it first. Terrible things have started happening in the night.

early.criticalSuccess: A hedge mage had offered to charm a plow so it would never dull. The charmed plow bit through rocky soil like butter, half the village came to watch, and the mage has more work than she can handle.
early.success: A hedge mage had offered to charm a plow so it would never dull. She charmed it with a song and a smear of oil, and the plow hasn't needed sharpening since.
early.failure: A hedge mage had offered to charm a plow so it would never dull. She charmed it, but the magic faded after a single season.
early.criticalFailure: A hedge mage had charmed a plow so it would never dull, and the plow went wild. It tore up the field and the fence and dragged its farmer through a hedge.

middle.criticalSuccess: Spellwrights had offered to enchant tools for the realm's workshops. The work goes faster and better than anyone dreamed, and their fame is drawing other craftsfolk to the realm.
middle.success: Spellwrights had offered to enchant tools for the realm's workshops. Their saws cut truer and their hammers ring cleaner, and the craftsfolk who bought them say they're worth every coin.
middle.failure: Spellwrights had offered to enchant tools for the realm's workshops, but their charms were fussy and expensive, and few workshops bothered.
middle.criticalFailure: Spellwrights had enchanted tools for the realm's workshops, and a batch of them exploded on a workbench. Craftsfolk won't touch enchanted tools now.

late.criticalSuccess: Wizards had proposed a foundry to make enchanted goods for trade. It was built, its goods are prized across the Inner Sea, and the coffers swell with every shipment.
late.success: Wizards had proposed a foundry that makes enchanted goods for trade. The foundry was built with its chimneys humming with odd colors, and its first goods are already on their way to market.
late.failure: Wizards had proposed a foundry to make enchanted goods for trade. It was built, but it costs more to run than it earns.
late.criticalFailure: Wizards had proposed a foundry to make enchanted goods for trade. A blast levelled the building and scattered wild magic across the district.

early.criticalSuccess: A farmer swore a witch had sent the hail that flattened his barley. The hail was shown to be plain bad weather, the witch helped him replant, and the two have become unlikely friends.
early.success: A farmer swore a witch had sent the hail that flattened his barley. A weather-wise elder showed him the hail had fallen across three valleys, not just his, and the witch was left in peace.
early.failure: A farmer swore a witch had sent the hail that flattened his barley. Nobody could prove it one way or the other, and he still curses her name at the market.
early.criticalFailure: A farmer swore a witch had sent the hail that flattened his barley, and he and his friends burned her cottage. She's gone, and her curses on the village are real now.

middle.criticalSuccess: A rainmaker's spell had gone wrong, and it hadn't stopped raining for two weeks. The broken spell was undone, the sun came out over a town that had nearly forgotten it, and the harvest was saved.
middle.success: A rainmaker's spell had gone wrong, and it hadn't stopped raining for two weeks. The rainmaker was helped to unpick the spell, the clouds finally broke, and the town is drying out.
middle.failure: A rainmaker's spell had gone wrong, and the rain wouldn't stop. It slowed to a drizzle but kept on, and the fields are soggy and tempers short.
middle.criticalFailure: A rainmaker's spell had gone wrong, and trying to undo it turned the rain into a storm. Fields have flooded and roofs have fallen in.

late.criticalSuccess: A magical storm had parked over a province and wouldn't move. It was unravelled at its heart, the clouds parted in a sky full of rainbows, and folks still call that day the Clearing.
late.success: A magical storm had parked over a province and wouldn't move. Spellcasters worked at it for days until it broke up and drifted away, and the province is drying out.
late.failure: A magical storm had parked over a province and wouldn't move. It weakened, but it's still there, and the province is drenched and miserable.
late.criticalFailure: A magical storm had parked over a province, and it grew worse instead of leaving. Lightning and floods are spreading across the land.

early.criticalSuccess: A traveling lecturer had wanted to talk about the stars in the village hall. He packed the place, half the children decided to become astronomers, and he's promised to come back every year.
early.success: A traveling lecturer wanted to talk about the stars in the village hall. The hall was full, folks asked good questions, and several went outside afterward to look up at the sky.
early.failure: A traveling lecturer had wanted to talk about the stars in the village hall, but the village found him dull. Few came back the second night.
early.criticalFailure: A traveling lecturer had come to talk about the stars in the village hall, and insulted the village priest instead. He was run out of town, and folks are suspicious of scholars now.

middle.criticalSuccess: Scholars had wanted to hold public debates on philosophy and magic. The debates drew crowds from every town, and the realm is gaining a name as a place where great ideas are born.
middle.success: Scholars wanted to hold public debates on philosophy and magic. The debates drew a steady crowd, the arguments were sharp but civil, and folks are still arguing about them in the taverns.
middle.failure: Scholars had wanted to hold public debates on philosophy and magic, but hardly anyone came, and the scholars went home grumbling.
middle.criticalFailure: Scholars had wanted to hold public debates on philosophy and magic, and a debate turned into a brawl between rival schools. Several were hurt, and the society has broken up.

late.criticalSuccess: Sages from across the Inner Sea had wanted to gather in the capital. The symposium was a triumph, and the realm is now known as a seat of wisdom.
late.success: Sages from across the Inner Sea wanted to gather in the capital. The symposium ran for a week of talks and feasts, and the sages went home pleased with their welcome.
late.failure: Sages from across the Inner Sea had wanted to gather in the capital, but many never came, and those who did were unimpressed.
late.criticalFailure: Sages from across the Inner Sea had gathered in the capital, and the symposium ended in insults and walkouts. They're telling everyone the realm is a backwater.

early.criticalSuccess: Folks were pulling their savings from the village moneylender all at once. Word went round that the crown itself had put coin with him, the line at his door melted away, and by week's end folks were bringing their savings back.
early.success: Folks were pulling their savings from the village moneylender all at once. A little crown coin and a lot of reassurance calmed the rush, and his doors stayed open.
early.failure: Folks were pulling their savings from the village moneylender all at once. The rush slowed, but not before he turned some savers away empty-handed, and folks keep their coin under the mattress now.
early.criticalFailure: Folks were pulling their savings from the village moneylender all at once. He ran dry with half the village still in line and closed his doors for good, and the families who lost their savings blame the crown for standing by.

middle.criticalSuccess: A rumor had everyone pulling their coin from the counting houses. It was traced to a rival house and exposed, the crown stood behind the counting houses in public, and they're trusted more than before.
middle.success: A rumor had everyone pulling their coin from the counting houses. The crown stood behind the counting houses, and the panic calmed before any of them failed.
middle.failure: A rumor had everyone pulling their coin from the counting houses. The panic eased, but one house failed and took its savers' coin with it.
middle.criticalFailure: A rumor had everyone pulling their coin from the counting houses, and the panic spread until three failed. Trade in the town has stalled.

late.criticalSuccess: A great merchant bank had failed, and the realm's trade was seizing up. Its debts were taken over and its trade kept moving, and the realm came out of the crash with its credit stronger than its neighbors'.
late.success: A great merchant bank had failed, and the realm's trade was seizing up. The crash was weathered, and trade is slowly picking up again.
late.failure: A great merchant bank had failed, and the realm's trade was seizing up. It was weathered, but many merchants were ruined.
late.criticalFailure: A great merchant bank had failed, and the crash spread through the realm. Merchants are failing one after another.

early.criticalSuccess: A farmer had found good building stone in his back field. The quarry opened that spring, the stone proved fine and grey, and half the village has new stone chimneys.
early.success: A farmer had found good building stone in his back field. The quarry was opened, and the stone is going into the village's new walls and chimneys.
early.failure: A farmer had found good building stone in his back field. It was quarried, but it cracks easily, and builders aren't keen.
early.criticalFailure: A farmer had found good building stone in his back field, and the quarry pit flooded and swallowed the field. He's furious with the crown.

middle.criticalSuccess: Prospectors had found a seam of marble builders would pay well for. It was opened with skill, its stone is gracing temples across the region, and the prospectors and the crown both profited.
middle.success: Prospectors had found a seam of marble that builders would pay well for. The seam was opened, and builders are paying well for the stone.
middle.failure: Prospectors had found a seam of marble. It was opened, but the stone is flawed and fetches less than hoped.
middle.criticalFailure: Prospectors had found a seam of marble, and it collapsed during the dig. Workers were hurt.

late.criticalSuccess: Engineers had proposed a great quarry that could supply three nations. It opened, it does, and the realm's wealth and name have grown together.
late.success: Engineers proposed a great quarry that could supply three nations. The quarry was opened, and its stone is selling abroad.
late.failure: Engineers had proposed a great quarry to supply three nations. It opened, but it costs more to run than it earns.
late.criticalFailure: Engineers had proposed a great quarry to supply three nations, and it became a disaster of cave-ins and debt.

early.criticalSuccess: The mill hands had walked off the job over wages. Their complaint was heard and met fairly, they came back to work with a song, and the mill has never run smoother.
early.success: The mill hands had walked off the job over wages. They got a fair raise and went back to work.
early.failure: The mill hands had walked off the job over wages. They went back, but they're still sore about it.
early.criticalFailure: The mill hands had walked off the job over wages, and the owner brought in strikebreakers. A fight left the mill damaged.

middle.criticalSuccess: A guild had stopped work across the town until its demands were met. A clever compromise suited everyone, and the town's work is back on track.
middle.success: A guild had stopped work across the town until its demands were met. A fair deal was struck, and work started again.
middle.failure: A guild had stopped work across the town. The strike ended, but the guild is still unhappy.
middle.criticalFailure: A guild had stopped work across the town, and the strike dragged on and turned violent.

late.criticalSuccess: Workers across the realm had put down their tools. A new charter for workers ended the strike, and the realm's workshops are humming again.
late.success: Workers across the realm had put down their tools. The general strike was settled, and folks went back to work.
late.failure: Workers across the realm had put down their tools. It was settled, but many workers are still angry.
late.criticalFailure: Workers across the realm had put down their tools, and the strike turned into riots.

early.criticalSuccess: Trappers had fine furs and wanted a buyer who paid fair. The furs fetched a price that made them whoop, and a Restov fur buyer now visits every season.
early.success: Trappers had fine furs and wanted a buyer who paid fair. A buyer was found who paid well, and the trappers will be back next season.
early.failure: Trappers had fine furs and wanted a fair buyer. They sold, but for less than they hoped.
early.criticalFailure: Trappers had fine furs and wanted a fair buyer, and they were cheated. They won't trade in the realm again.

middle.criticalSuccess: A spice merchant wanted to open a shop and bring in rare goods. Her shop is a wonder, and folks travel from far away to buy from her.
middle.success: A spice merchant wanted to open a shop and bring in rare goods. Her shop opened, and the smell of pepper and saffron draws buyers from the whole town.
middle.failure: A spice merchant wanted to open a shop and bring in rare goods. She opened it, but business is slow.
middle.criticalFailure: A spice merchant wanted to open a shop, and her goods were stolen before it opened. She left in a rage.

late.criticalSuccess: Merchants from far away wanted the realm as a stop on their luxury route. It became one, rare goods flow through its markets, and the coffers overflow.
late.success: Merchants from far away wanted the realm as a stop on their luxury route. The realm became a stop, and rare goods are passing through its markets.
late.failure: Merchants from far away wanted the realm as a stop on their luxury route. It became one, but few merchants come.
late.criticalFailure: Merchants from far away wanted the realm as a stop on their luxury route, and they moved it elsewhere. The chance was missed.

early.criticalSuccess: Farmers had wanted a windmill so they could stop hauling grain to the river mill. It went up on the hill, its sails turned in the first good breeze, and the farmers hauled their grain up the hill singing.
early.success: Farmers wanted a windmill so they could stop hauling grain to the river mill. It went up on the hill above the village, and the long haul to the river is over.
early.failure: Farmers had wanted a windmill so they could stop hauling grain to the river. It was built, but it's slow and grinds poorly.
early.criticalFailure: Farmers had wanted a windmill so they could stop hauling grain to the river. Its sails tore off in the first storm, and the mill was ruined.

middle.criticalSuccess: The town had wanted a proper granary to keep grain through bad years. It was built and filled, and when the next bad year came, the town didn't go hungry. Folks bless the crown every winter.
middle.success: The town wanted a proper granary to keep grain through bad years. It was built of good stone on a dry rise, and it's being filled sack by sack.
middle.failure: The town had wanted a proper granary to keep grain through bad years. It was built, but rats got in, and much of the grain was lost.
middle.criticalFailure: The town had wanted a proper granary to keep grain through bad years. It caught fire soon after it was filled, and the grain went with it.

late.criticalSuccess: Engineers had proposed granaries in every province to end hunger for good. They rose across the realm, the stores will last a decade, and hunger is becoming a thing of the past.
late.success: Engineers had proposed granaries in every province to end hunger for good. They were built across the realm and are filling up, and the realm is far safer from famine.
late.failure: Engineers had proposed granaries in every province, but only some were built, and many provinces are still unprotected.
late.criticalFailure: Engineers had proposed granaries in every province, and the plan sank in graft and waste. The realm has nothing to show for it.

early.criticalSuccess: The creek had gone over its banks and put the low fields under water. The village dug a new channel to drain them, the water was gone in two days, and the creek has stayed in its banks since.
early.success: The creek had gone over its banks and put the low fields under water. A channel was cut to drain them, and the low fields are dry again.
early.failure: The creek had gone over its banks and put the low fields under water. The water went down slowly, and much of the planting was lost.
early.criticalFailure: The creek had gone over its banks and put the low fields under water, then it washed out the village's stores. The village will be hungry this winter.

middle.criticalSuccess: The river had flooded a town, and families were stranded on their roofs. Boats pulled every one of them to safety, and the town has been rebuilt on higher ground.
middle.success: The river had flooded a town, and families were stranded on their roofs. Boats were rowed through the streets, and the families were brought to safety.
middle.failure: The river had flooded a town, and families were stranded on their roofs. Most were saved, but some lost their homes and their animals.
middle.criticalFailure: The river had flooded a town, and families were stranded on their roofs. The rescuers came too late, and many were lost.

late.criticalSuccess: Floods had swallowed whole valleys, and the waters weren't going down. The valleys were drained and saved, and the realm built dikes that will hold such floods back for good.
late.success: Floods had swallowed whole valleys, and the waters weren't going down. Dikes were raised and channels cut, the waters were held back, and the valleys are slowly drying out.
late.failure: Floods had swallowed whole valleys. The waters went down at last, but the damage was terrible, and many lost everything.
late.criticalFailure: Floods had swallowed whole valleys, and they swallowed more before they went down. Thousands are homeless.

early.criticalSuccess: A traveler had offered apple saplings from a famous orchard. They took root and bore fruit in record time, and folks say the village cider is the best in the River Kingdoms.
early.success: A traveler had offered apple saplings from a famous orchard. They were planted along the south slope, and they're growing well.
early.failure: A traveler had offered apple saplings from a famous orchard. They were planted, but half died in the first frost.
early.criticalFailure: A traveler had offered apple saplings from a famous orchard. They carried a blight, and it spread to the village's old trees.

middle.criticalSuccess: A winemaker thought the realm's hills could grow good grapes. The vineyard took to the slopes beautifully, its first wine was praised across the region, and the winemaker is rich and famous.
middle.success: A winemaker thought the realm's hills could grow good grapes. The vineyard was planted on the sunny side of the valley, and the first grapes are coming along.
middle.failure: A winemaker thought the realm's hills could grow good grapes. The vineyard was planted, but the grapes are sour.
middle.criticalFailure: A winemaker thought the realm's hills could grow good grapes. The vines died in the first year, and the winemaker left in disgust.

late.criticalSuccess: Gardeners had proposed great orchards whose fruit would be known across the Inner Sea. The royal orchards bloomed, and the realm's fruit is spoken of with envy in distant markets.
late.success: Gardeners had proposed great orchards whose fruit would be known across the Inner Sea. The royal orchards were planted, and they're starting to bear.
late.failure: Gardeners had proposed great royal orchards. They were planted, but they're struggling, and few have fruit.
late.criticalFailure: Gardeners had proposed great royal orchards. Blight ruined them, and the realm's investment was lost.

early.criticalSuccess: Grasshoppers were eating a farmer's oats down to the dirt. They were driven off with smoke and clever traps, the oats recovered, and the farmer is now the village's expert on pests.
early.success: Grasshoppers were eating a farmer's oats down to the dirt. Smoke fires and chickens drove them out of the field before the crop was lost.
early.failure: Grasshoppers were eating a farmer's oats down to the dirt. They were driven off, but they took most of the oats with them.
early.criticalFailure: Grasshoppers were eating a farmer's oats down to the dirt, and they spread to the neighbors' fields. The village's crop is lost.

middle.criticalSuccess: A swarm of locusts was moving through the farmland. It was turned away with smoke and fire, the crops were saved, and the farmers are calling it a miracle.
middle.success: A swarm of locusts was moving through the farmland. Smoke fires along its path turned it aside, and it did little damage before it moved on.
middle.failure: A swarm of locusts was moving through the farmland. It passed on, but it ate much of the crop along the way.
middle.criticalFailure: A swarm of locusts was moving through the farmland, and it stripped the fields bare. The region faces hunger.

late.criticalSuccess: Locusts had darkened the sky over three provinces. A great ritual turned them back, the sky cleared, and the realm's priests are celebrated everywhere.
late.success: Locusts had darkened the sky over three provinces. Priests and farmers fought them with ritual and fire, and they were driven off before they could do their worst.
late.failure: Locusts had darkened the sky over three provinces. They passed on, but left much of the land bare.
late.criticalFailure: Locusts had darkened the sky over three provinces, and they stripped them bare. Famine is spreading.

early.criticalSuccess: A hermit in the woods knew every path and might share them, for company. He was visited, shared his paths for news and conversation, and now comes to the village every market day.
early.success: A hermit in the woods knew every path and might share them, for company. He was visited, and over tea he shared some of his paths.
early.failure: A hermit in the woods knew every path. He shared a few, but he's still wary.
early.criticalFailure: A hermit in the woods knew every path, and he was offended by his visitors. He's vanished deeper into the woods.

middle.criticalSuccess: Druids had offered to tend the forest if the crown left their grove alone. The grove was left alone, and the forest is healthier than it's been in a century.
middle.success: Druids had offered to tend the forest if the crown left their grove alone. The bargain was struck, and the druids are tending the forest.
middle.failure: Druids had offered to tend the forest if their grove was left alone. They agreed, but they're suspicious of the crown.
middle.criticalFailure: Druids had offered to tend the forest if their grove was left alone, and the crown's woodcutters strayed into it. The druids have turned against the realm.

late.criticalSuccess: Druids, rangers and fey had proposed a pact to watch over the wild lands together. The green council was formed, and the realm's wilds are safe in its hands.
late.success: Druids, rangers and fey had proposed a pact to watch over the wild lands together. The green council was formed, and it watches the wilds.
late.failure: Druids, rangers and fey had proposed a pact to watch the wild lands. The council was formed, but its members quarrel.
late.criticalFailure: Druids, rangers and fey had proposed a pact to watch the wild lands, and it fell apart. The fey have turned hostile.

early.criticalSuccess: Travelers said something under the old bridge asked them riddles. It turned out to be a lonely gnome, he was given a proper post as bridge-keeper, and travelers enjoy his riddles now.
early.success: Travelers said something under the old bridge asked them riddles. It was persuaded to leave them alone, and folks cross without being stopped.
early.failure: Travelers said something under the old bridge asked them riddles, and it still does.
early.criticalFailure: Travelers said something under the old bridge asked them riddles, and it dragged a traveler under. Nobody uses the bridge now.

middle.criticalSuccess: A troll had moved under a busy bridge and was eating anyone who wouldn't pay. It was driven off for good, the bridge is safe, and the bards are singing about it.
middle.success: A troll had moved under a busy bridge and was eating anyone who wouldn't pay. It was driven out with fire and spears, and the bridge is open again.
middle.failure: A troll had moved under a busy bridge. It was driven off, but it comes back at night.
middle.criticalFailure: A troll had moved under a busy bridge, and it ate the hunters sent after it. The bridge is closed.

late.criticalSuccess: A clan of trolls had taken a mountain pass and closed it. They were driven from the pass, it's open again, and trade is flowing.
late.success: A clan of trolls had taken a mountain pass and closed it. They were driven out of the pass, and the pass is open again.
late.failure: A clan of trolls had taken a mountain pass. They were driven back, but they still raid it now and then.
late.criticalFailure: A clan of trolls had taken a mountain pass, and they beat off the attack. The pass is closed for good.

early.criticalSuccess: Kids had found a cave behind the waterfall that went a long way back. It was explored and mapped, it turned out to be a beautiful grotto, and folks come from miles to see it.
early.success: Kids had found a cave behind the waterfall that went a long way back. It was explored and mapped, and it's safe for the kids to play in.
early.failure: Kids had found a cave behind the waterfall. It was explored, but the explorers got lost and turned back.
early.criticalFailure: Kids had found a cave behind the waterfall, and a child got lost in it. They were found only after a desperate search.

middle.criticalSuccess: Explorers had found caves running under half the province. They were mapped, they hold rich veins of ore, and miners are already at work.
middle.success: Explorers had found caves running under half the province. They were mapped from end to end, and the map is worth having.
middle.failure: Explorers had found caves running under half the province. They were partly mapped, but they go on and on.
middle.criticalFailure: Explorers had found caves running under half the province, and got lost in them. Some never came out.

late.criticalSuccess: Delvers had found a passage that led very deep, and something down there noticed. The passage was sealed before anything came up, and the delvers came back with treasures from the dark.
late.success: Delvers had found a passage that led very deep, and something down there noticed. They explored it carefully, and came back safely.
late.failure: Delvers had found a passage that led very deep. They came back, but something has followed them up.
late.criticalFailure: Delvers had found a passage that led very deep, and something came up it. The delvers didn't come back.

early.criticalSuccess: A boar had torn up three gardens and charged a child. It was tracked down and roasted at a village feast, and the child it charged got the first slice.
early.success: A boar had torn up three gardens and charged a child. It was hunted down and killed, and the village had pork for a week.
early.failure: A boar had torn up three gardens and charged a child. It was driven off, but it's still around.
early.criticalFailure: A boar had torn up three gardens and charged a child, and it gored a hunter. It's still loose.

middle.criticalSuccess: A huge bear had claimed the town orchard and wouldn't leave. It was coaxed out and led to the wilds without harm, and the town has its orchard back.
middle.success: A huge bear had claimed the town orchard and wouldn't leave. It was driven out with dogs and torches, and the orchard is the town's again.
middle.failure: A huge bear had claimed the town orchard. It was driven off, but it keeps coming back.
middle.criticalFailure: A huge bear had claimed the town orchard, and it mauled the hunters. It still holds the orchard.

late.criticalSuccess: Owlbears were coming out of the forest in numbers nobody had seen before. They were driven back and their nests cleared, and the realm is safe.
late.success: Owlbears were coming out of the forest in numbers nobody had seen before. They were driven back into the forest, and the farms are safe.
late.failure: Owlbears were coming out of the forest in numbers nobody had seen. They were driven back, but many are still loose.
late.criticalFailure: Owlbears were coming out of the forest in numbers nobody had seen, and they overran several farms. Folks are fleeing.

archaeological-find.criticalSuccess: A remote ruin in the realm's lands was thought to hold relics of the people who came before. The dig turned up treasures of that older people, and the whole realm is proud of its deep roots.
archaeological-find.success: A remote ruin in the realm's lands was thought to hold relics of the people who came before. The diggers brought out a few fine pieces and a story worth telling.
archaeological-find.failure: A remote ruin in the realm's lands was thought to hold relics of the people who came before, but weeks of digging turned up only broken pots. The ruin keeps its secrets.
archaeological-find.criticalFailure: A remote ruin in the realm's lands was thought to hold relics of the people who came before. The dig collapsed on itself, and whatever was down there is buried again.

assassination-attempt.criticalSuccess: Someone had hired killers to strike at the court. The killers were caught in the act of slipping into the palace, and under questioning they named the one who hired them.
assassination-attempt.success: Someone had hired killers to strike at the court. The guards were ready when they came, and the attempt was foiled before any blade was drawn.
assassination-attempt.failure: Someone had hired killers to strike at the court. The attempt failed, but the killers got away into the night, and the court sleeps badly now.
assassination-attempt.criticalFailure: Someone had hired killers to strike at the court, and a blade found its mark before the guards could stop it. The realm is shaken.

bandit-activity.criticalSuccess: Caravans along the realm's roads were being robbed. The bandits were tracked to their camp and broken, and the roads are safer than they've been in years.
bandit-activity.success: Caravans along the realm's roads were being robbed. Patrols drove the bandits off the roads, and the caravans move freely again.
bandit-activity.failure: Caravans along the realm's roads were being robbed. The patrols scared the bandits into lying low, but they're still out there, waiting.
bandit-activity.criticalFailure: Caravans along the realm's roads were being robbed, and the bandits grew so bold they raided a settlement outright.

boomtown.criticalSuccess: Trade was booming in one of the realm's smaller towns. The boom was handled well, roads and markets kept up with it, and the town is growing into a real center of trade.
boomtown.success: Trade was booming in one of the realm's smaller towns. The crown took its share, and the boom brought good money into the treasury.
boomtown.failure: Trade was booming in one of the realm's smaller towns, but it fizzled out before anyone could make much of it.
boomtown.criticalFailure: Trade was booming in one of the realm's smaller towns, and nobody kept order. The boom turned into a scramble of cheats and thieves.

building-demand.criticalSuccess: Townsfolk were demanding that a building be raised, or torn down. They got their way, and they're delighted with the result and grateful the crown listened.
building-demand.success: Townsfolk were demanding that a building be raised, or torn down. The demand was met, and the grumbling stopped.
building-demand.failure: Townsfolk were demanding that a building be raised, or torn down. Their demand went unanswered, and they grumble about it in the market.
building-demand.criticalFailure: Townsfolk were demanding that a building be raised, or torn down. They were ignored, and their demand turned into protest in the streets.

crop-failure.criticalSuccess: Blight had struck the realm's fields. It was stopped cold by quick burning and good advice, and the fields recovered in time for the harvest.
crop-failure.success: Blight had struck the realm's fields. The worst of it was burned out, and the damage was contained.
crop-failure.failure: Blight had struck the realm's fields. It was fought, but it took a good part of the harvest before it was beaten.
crop-failure.criticalFailure: Blight had struck the realm's fields, and it spread faster than anyone could burn it. Hunger is following.

cult-activity.criticalSuccess: Citizens were vanishing, and whispers spoke of a hidden temple. The temple was found beneath an old cellar, the cult was rooted out, and its captives were brought home alive.
cult-activity.success: Citizens were vanishing, and whispers spoke of a hidden temple. Its hiding places were found, and the cult has been pushed back.
cult-activity.failure: Citizens were vanishing, and whispers spoke of a hidden temple. The temple was found empty; the cult had slipped away to hide somewhere else.
cult-activity.criticalFailure: Citizens were vanishing, and whispers spoke of a hidden temple. The search came up empty, the cult grew bolder, and more people have vanished.

diplomatic-overture.criticalSuccess: An envoy had arrived seeking an audience with the court. The talks went splendidly, and the envoy left with a firm promise of friendship and a gift for the court.
diplomatic-overture.success: An envoy had arrived seeking an audience with the court. The talks went well, and the envoy promised to write.
diplomatic-overture.failure: An envoy had arrived seeking an audience with the court. The talks were polite, and they ended with nothing agreed.
diplomatic-overture.criticalFailure: An envoy had arrived seeking an audience with the court, and left insulted. The neighbor's court has heard all about it.

discovery.criticalSuccess: The realm's scholars believed they were close to a breakthrough. It came, it was real, and the realm's scholars are the talk of the region.
discovery.success: The realm's scholars believed they were close to a breakthrough. The work bore fruit, and they have something to show for it.
discovery.failure: The realm's scholars believed they were close to a breakthrough, but it never came. The notes went back on the shelf.
discovery.criticalFailure: The realm's scholars believed they were close to a breakthrough, and the final experiment went badly wrong. A workshop burned.

drug-den.criticalSuccess: Something was poisoning the back streets. The den behind it was raided, its suppliers were caught, and the streets cleared within a month.
drug-den.success: Something was poisoning the back streets. The watch followed the sick back to a cellar den, and it was shut down and its stock poured into the gutter.
drug-den.failure: Something was poisoning the back streets. The den closed, but it opened again a few streets over.
drug-den.criticalFailure: Something was poisoning the back streets, and while the watch looked the other way the poison spread further.

economic-surge.criticalSuccess: Markets were booming across the realm. The crown rode the boom wisely, investing where it counted and taxing lightly, and the treasury swelled.
economic-surge.success: Markets were booming across the realm. The realm's merchants did well, and the crown took its fair share of the good times.
economic-surge.failure: Markets were booming across the realm, but the boom passed the realm by before it could profit.
economic-surge.criticalFailure: Markets were booming across the realm, and then the boom collapsed into a slump. Debts are being called in.

expansion-demand.criticalSuccess: Settlers were restless for new land. They were given good land to settle, and they bless the crown for it.
expansion-demand.success: Settlers were restless for new land. Some were found plots on the edge of the realm, and the demand is quiet, for now.
expansion-demand.failure: Settlers were restless for new land, and nothing was done. They're starting to look past the border.
expansion-demand.criticalFailure: Settlers were restless for new land, and they took matters into their own hands. They've moved onto land that isn't theirs.

festive-invitation.criticalSuccess: An ally had invited the court to their festival. The court shone there, from the feasting to the dancing, and the friendship between the two realms has deepened.
festive-invitation.success: An ally had invited the court to their festival. The visit was a pleasant one, and the hosts were pleased.
festive-invitation.failure: An ally had invited the court to their festival. The visit was forgettable, and the hosts have already forgotten it.
festive-invitation.criticalFailure: An ally had invited the court to their festival, and the visit ended in an embarrassing scene that both courts will remember.

feud.criticalSuccess: Two towns' leading families were at each other's throats. They were brought to the table and reconciled, and a marriage between them has sealed the peace.
feud.success: Two towns' leading families were at each other's throats. After long, bitter talks a truce was struck, and the two families nod coldly at market.
feud.failure: Two towns' leading families were at each other's throats. Nothing was settled, and the feud smolders on, waiting for a spark.
feud.criticalFailure: Two towns' leading families were at each other's throats, and the feud turned bloody. A son of each house is dead, and both towns are taking sides.

food-shortage.criticalSuccess: The granaries were running low. Careful rationing and a few clever deals saw the realm through, and nobody went hungry.
food-shortage.success: The granaries were running low. Rationing was strict but fair, and it stretched the stores until the next harvest came in.
food-shortage.failure: The granaries were running low. Rationing came too late, and some families went hungry before the shortage ended.
food-shortage.criticalFailure: The granaries were running low, and hunger turned to anger. The anger has turned on the crown.

food-surplus.criticalSuccess: The harvest was bountiful. The surplus was stored and traded wisely, and the realm will eat well for a long time.
food-surplus.success: The harvest was bountiful. The surplus was stored and sold sensibly, and the realm is the better for it.
food-surplus.failure: The harvest was bountiful, but nobody had planned where to keep it. Much of the surplus spoiled in the barns before it could be used.
food-surplus.criticalFailure: The harvest was bountiful, and the surplus was squandered in a season of waste and feasting. By spring the barns were bare.

good-weather.criticalSuccess: A run of fine weather had lifted every spirit. The crown made full use of it with fairs and outdoor work, and the whole realm is in good spirits.
good-weather.success: A run of fine weather had lifted every spirit. Folks worked in the sun and sang in the evenings, and the realm is cheerful.
good-weather.failure: A run of fine weather had lifted every spirit, but it turned before anyone could make the most of it.
good-weather.criticalFailure: A run of fine weather had lifted every spirit, and then it broke into a violent storm.

inquisition.criticalSuccess: Zealots were stirring the crowds against their neighbors. They were calmed with patience and plain words, and the neighbors have made peace.
inquisition.success: Zealots were stirring the crowds against their neighbors. Their leaders were spoken to firmly, and they were quieted before anyone was hurt.
inquisition.failure: Zealots were stirring the crowds against their neighbors. Nothing stopped them, and they're still preaching hate on the street corners.
inquisition.criticalFailure: Zealots were stirring the crowds against their neighbors, and the crowds turned on those neighbors. Blood was spilled.

justice-prevails.criticalSuccess: A long-standing injustice had finally been put right. The verdict was celebrated in the streets, and faith in the crown has grown.
justice-prevails.success: A long-standing injustice had finally been put right. The news was cried in the squares, and the realm takes heart from it.
justice-prevails.failure: A long-standing injustice had finally been put right, but the news was handled so quietly that folks barely noticed.
justice-prevails.criticalFailure: A long-standing injustice had finally been put right, and then the case was reopened and the old wrong came back.

land-rush.criticalSuccess: Settlers were squabbling over land just past the border. Fair surveys were made, and the new land was settled in good order.
land-rush.success: Settlers were squabbling over land just past the border. Surveyors walked the claims and drew fair lines, and the squabbles were settled.
land-rush.failure: Settlers were squabbling over land just past the border. No one drew the lines, and the quarrels go on from one season to the next.
land-rush.criticalFailure: Settlers were squabbling over land just past the border, and the quarrels turned violent. Fences were burned, and someone was killed.

local-disaster.criticalSuccess: Fire, flood or collapse had struck one of the realm's settlements. Help came swiftly, and the settlement is rebuilding stronger than before.
local-disaster.success: Fire, flood or collapse had struck one of the realm's settlements. The response was quick enough to contain the damage.
local-disaster.failure: Fire, flood or collapse had struck one of the realm's settlements. The damage is heavy, and it will take a long time to put right.
local-disaster.criticalFailure: Fire, flood or collapse had struck one of the realm's settlements, and it spread before anyone could stop it.

monster-activity.criticalSuccess: Something large was killing livestock out in the wilds. Hunters tracked it to its lair and slew it, and its hide hangs in the hall.
monster-activity.success: Something large was killing livestock out in the wilds. It was driven back into the deep woods.
monster-activity.failure: Something large was killing livestock out in the wilds. The hunters couldn't find it, and it's still out there.
monster-activity.criticalFailure: Something large was killing livestock out in the wilds. The hunters missed it, and it came down from the wilds and struck a settlement.

natural-disaster.criticalSuccess: Storm, fire or flood was sweeping across the land. The realm weathered it well, and the way everyone pulled together will be remembered.
natural-disaster.success: Storm, fire or flood was sweeping across the land. Good preparation and quick work kept the damage limited.
natural-disaster.failure: Storm, fire or flood was sweeping across the land. Folks did what they could, but the damage is widespread and costly.
natural-disaster.criticalFailure: Storm, fire or flood was sweeping across the land, and nobody was ready. It devastated whole stretches of the realm.

natures-blessing.criticalSuccess: A rare wonder of nature had the whole realm talking. Visitors came from far away to see it, and the realm's name spread with them.
natures-blessing.success: A rare wonder of nature had the whole realm talking, and folks enjoyed it while it lasted.
natures-blessing.failure: A rare wonder of nature had the whole realm talking, but it faded before many people saw it.
natures-blessing.criticalFailure: A rare wonder of nature had the whole realm talking, and careless visitors trampled it into nothing.

new-subjects.criticalSuccess: Newcomers had asked to settle under the realm's banner. They settled in quickly, and they've added to the realm's strength.
new-subjects.success: Newcomers had asked to settle under the realm's banner. They were welcomed, given land and a place at the table, and they're settling in.
new-subjects.failure: Newcomers had asked to settle under the realm's banner. They were let in, but they're struggling to fit in.
new-subjects.criticalFailure: Newcomers had asked to settle under the realm's banner, and they were turned away. They left bitter.

noblesse-oblige.criticalSuccess: A wealthy family had offered to beautify the town. Their gift of gardens, fountains and fresh paint has turned it into a jewel of the realm.
noblesse-oblige.success: A wealthy family had offered to beautify the town, and the town is a little finer for it.
noblesse-oblige.failure: A wealthy family had offered to beautify the town, but the gift turned out smaller than promised.
noblesse-oblige.criticalFailure: A wealthy family had offered to beautify the town, and the gift came with strings that are causing trouble at court.

outstanding-success.criticalSuccess: One of the realm's citizens had made something remarkable. The work is celebrated far and wide, and the realm basks in the glow.
outstanding-success.success: One of the realm's citizens had made something remarkable, and it has brought the realm some pride.
outstanding-success.failure: One of the realm's citizens had made something remarkable, but nobody thought to show it off, and it went mostly unnoticed.
outstanding-success.criticalFailure: One of the realm's citizens had made something remarkable, and it was stolen and claimed by someone else.

pilgrimage.criticalSuccess: Pilgrims were streaming toward the realm's shrines. They were welcomed and cared for along the way, and the shrines' fame is growing.
pilgrimage.success: Pilgrims were streaming toward the realm's shrines. Inns and shrines found room for them, and they were looked after.
pilgrimage.failure: Pilgrims were streaming toward the realm's shrines. They prayed, they passed through, and they left nothing much behind them, good or bad.
pilgrimage.criticalFailure: Pilgrims were streaming toward the realm's shrines, and they brought trouble with them. The roads are crowded with it.

plague.criticalSuccess: Sickness was spreading through the streets. It was caught early with quarantines and good care, and the healers are heroes.
plague.success: Sickness was spreading through the streets. Healers and quarantines contained it before it could reach the other towns.
plague.failure: Sickness was spreading through the streets. The healers worked day and night, but it took many before it passed.
plague.criticalFailure: Sickness was spreading through the streets, and the quarantines failed. It has spread across the realm.

political-calm.criticalSuccess: For once, the court was quiet and the people approved. The quiet season was used well, and the realm got a great deal done.
political-calm.success: For once, the court was quiet and the people approved. The calm held through the season, and everyone breathed a little easier.
political-calm.failure: For once, the court was quiet and the people approved, but a petty quarrel broke the calm within weeks.
political-calm.criticalFailure: For once, the court was quiet and the people approved, and then the calm shattered in a burst of quarreling.

public-scandal.criticalSuccess: One of the realm's officials was at the center of an embarrassing affair. The scandal was turned around, and the official came out of it cleared.
public-scandal.success: One of the realm's officials was at the center of an embarrassing affair, and the scandal faded.
public-scandal.failure: One of the realm's officials was at the center of an embarrassing affair, and the scandal lingers.
public-scandal.criticalFailure: One of the realm's officials was at the center of an embarrassing affair, and it grows with every new detail.

remarkable-treasure.criticalSuccess: Foreign adventurers had struck it rich in the realm's wilds. The treasure was shared fairly, and it has enriched the realm.
remarkable-treasure.success: Foreign adventurers had struck it rich in the realm's wilds. They paid the crown its due share before they left, with only a little grumbling.
remarkable-treasure.failure: Foreign adventurers had struck it rich in the realm's wilds, and they slipped across the border with every coin before anyone could ask for a share.
remarkable-treasure.criticalFailure: Foreign adventurers had struck it rich in the realm's wilds, and the treasure started a feud over who it belongs to.

sacrifices.criticalSuccess: People were being taken from the roads at night. The cult behind it was found and destroyed, and its altar was smashed.
sacrifices.success: People were being taken from the roads at night. Patrols were posted at every crossroads, and the disappearances stopped.
sacrifices.failure: People were being taken from the roads at night. Patrols slowed the disappearances, but didn't stop them.
sacrifices.criticalFailure: People were being taken from the roads at night. The patrols found nothing, and more people have been taken since.

sensational-crime.criticalSuccess: A notorious criminal was making fools of the watch. The criminal was caught in a famous arrest that the bards will sing about.
sensational-crime.success: A notorious criminal was making fools of the watch. The watch laid a careful trap, and the criminal walked into it.
sensational-crime.failure: A notorious criminal was making fools of the watch, and the watch was made fools of once more. The criminal slipped away again.
sensational-crime.criticalFailure: A notorious criminal was making fools of the watch, and after the latest chase they struck again, more boldly than ever.

squatters.criticalSuccess: Families with nowhere to go had camped on an empty lot. They were given homes, and they've turned out to be good neighbors.
squatters.success: Families with nowhere to go had camped on an empty lot. They were found somewhere better to live, and the lot is clear.
squatters.failure: Families with nowhere to go had camped on an empty lot. Nobody found them anywhere better, and they're still there.
squatters.criticalFailure: Families with nowhere to go had camped on an empty lot, and the camp has grown, and so has the trouble.

undead-uprising.criticalSuccess: The dead were not staying in their graves. Priests and soldiers laid them to rest for good, and the graveyards are quiet again.
undead-uprising.success: The dead were not staying in their graves. Priests and soldiers walked the graveyards at night and put them down.
undead-uprising.failure: The dead were not staying in their graves. They were put down, but they keep rising again.
undead-uprising.criticalFailure: The dead were not staying in their graves, and they came out in numbers and overwhelmed a settlement.

unexpected-find.criticalSuccess: Workers had dug up something that glows. It proved to be a wonder, and scholars are coming from far away to see it.
unexpected-find.success: Workers had dug up something that glows. Scholars studied it, and it proved useful to the realm.
unexpected-find.failure: Workers had dug up something that glows. Scholars studied it for weeks, and it's a curiosity and nothing more.
unexpected-find.criticalFailure: Workers had dug up something that glows, and the workers who handled it fell ill. It's dangerous.

vandals.criticalSuccess: Someone was wrecking property under cover of night. The vandals were caught and made to repair everything they wrecked.
vandals.success: Someone was wrecking property under cover of night. The watch caught the vandals red-handed, and that was the end of it.
vandals.failure: Someone was wrecking property under cover of night. The watch never caught them, and they still strike now and then.
vandals.criticalFailure: Someone was wrecking property under cover of night, and nobody caught them. The damage spreads night after night.

visiting-celebrity.criticalSuccess: News of a famous visitor had the town up all night preparing a feast. The visit was a triumph, and the celebrity is telling everyone about the realm's hospitality.
visiting-celebrity.success: News of a famous visitor had the town up all night preparing a feast. The visit went well, and the guest left happy.
visiting-celebrity.failure: News of a visiting celebrity had the villagers up all night making preparations for a feast, but the famous guest's snooty attitude and dull manner caused the event to sour.
visiting-celebrity.criticalFailure: News of a famous visitor had the town up all night preparing a feast, and the visit was a disaster. The celebrity is telling everyone about it, loudly.

wealthy-immigrant.criticalSuccess: A rich foreigner wanted to build an estate in the capital. The estate went up, and the newcomer's money is enriching the whole capital.
wealthy-immigrant.success: A rich foreigner wanted to build an estate in the capital. The estate went up, and the newcomer has settled in comfortably.
wealthy-immigrant.failure: A rich foreigner wanted to build an estate in the capital, but changed their mind and left.
wealthy-immigrant.criticalFailure: A rich foreigner wanted to build an estate in the capital, and they're causing trouble with the old families.

public-outbreak.criticalSuccess: Fear of the bloom-curse was spreading. Calm voices and quick quarantines turned the fear into resolve, and the realm is bracing together.
public-outbreak.success: Fear of the bloom-curse was spreading. Plain talk from the crown and the temples settled it before it turned to panic.
public-outbreak.failure: Fear of the bloom-curse was spreading. Nothing said seemed to help, and it keeps spreading from village to village.
public-outbreak.criticalFailure: Fear of the bloom-curse was spreading, and it boiled over. Neighbors have turned on anyone who looks sick.

too-close-to-home.criticalSuccess: Something had burst out of a citizen and was loose in the countryside. It was hunted down before it could hurt anyone else, and the family was cared for.
too-close-to-home.success: Something had burst out of a citizen and was loose in the countryside. It was tracked and destroyed.
too-close-to-home.failure: Something had burst out of a citizen and was loose in the countryside. It slipped away from the hunters.
too-close-to-home.criticalFailure: Something had burst out of a citizen and was loose in the countryside, and it struck again before anyone could find it.

urban-outbreak.criticalSuccess: A monster had erupted in the middle of town. It was cornered and killed in the square, and the town cheers its defenders.
urban-outbreak.success: A monster had erupted in the middle of town. It was put down, though the street is a wreck.
urban-outbreak.failure: A monster had erupted in the middle of town. Its defenders drove it off, but it wasn't killed, and it's still out there.
urban-outbreak.criticalFailure: A monster had erupted in the middle of town, and it tore through the streets before it was stopped.

claim-hex.criticalSuccess: Surveyors walked the new land, settled the boundary and raised the realm's banner over it. The stakes were barely in before the first families were moving in.
claim-hex.success: Surveyors walked the new land, settled the boundary and raised the realm's banner. The hex is the realm's now.
claim-hex.failure: Surveyors went out to settle the boundary of the new land, but the claim didn't take: the markers were disputed and the banner came down again.
claim-hex.criticalFailure: Surveyors went out to claim the new land, and it ended badly. Their camp was raided, the markers were lost, and the effort was wasted.

build-road.criticalSuccess: The road crew cut and paved a road through the hex, laid straight and true. Wagons were rolling on it before the last stone was set.
build-road.success: The road crew cut and paved a road through the hex. It's finished, and travel is quicker for it.
build-road.failure: The road crew set out to cut and pave a road through the hex, but the ground fought them every step, and they couldn't finish the stretch.
build-road.criticalFailure: The road crew set out to cut and pave a road through the hex, and the first heavy rain washed the new work out before it was done.

establish-farmland.criticalSuccess: Workers cleared the fields, dug the ditches and planted the first crop. The new ground is rich, and the first harvest promises plenty.
establish-farmland.success: Workers cleared the fields, dug the ditches and planted the first crop. The new farmland is ready.
establish-farmland.failure: Workers set out to clear and plant new fields, but the ground wouldn't take a plow this season.
establish-farmland.criticalFailure: Workers set out to clear and plant new fields, and the ditches were cut wrong. The ground is waterlogged and ruined for a while.

establish-work-site.criticalSuccess: The crews opened the new quarry, mine or lumber camp, and it was up and running in record time. The first loads are already coming in.
establish-work-site.success: The crews opened the new quarry, mine or lumber camp, and the work site is set up.
establish-work-site.failure: The crews set out to open a new work site, but the work stalled on bad ground and short hands.
establish-work-site.criticalFailure: The crews set out to open a new work site, and it collapsed on them. The crew was hurt, and the site is abandoned.

found-settlement.criticalSuccess: Settlers, surveyors and well-diggers set out to found a new village. It rose fast, full of hope and hammering, and the first child born there was named for the realm.
found-settlement.success: Settlers, surveyors and well-diggers set out to found a new village. The first well was dug, the first houses raised, and the village is founded.
found-settlement.failure: Settlers, surveyors and well-diggers set out to found a new village, but a hard season wore them down, and the founding stalled.
found-settlement.criticalFailure: Settlers, surveyors and well-diggers set out to found a new village, and it failed. The well came up dry, and the settlers scattered.

build-structure.criticalSuccess: The builders went to work on the new building and finished it ahead of time. The town turned out to admire it.
build-structure.success: The builders went to work on the new building, and it's finished.
build-structure.failure: The builders went to work on the new building, but it isn't finished this time. Materials ran short and the work stopped.
build-structure.criticalFailure: The builders went to work on the new building, and part of it came down during the work. The effort and the materials were lost.

fortify-hex.criticalSuccess: Workers raised a watchtower and earthworks to guard the hex. The fortifications are strong, and anyone watching the border has taken note.
fortify-hex.success: Workers raised a watchtower and earthworks to guard the hex. The fortifications are up.
fortify-hex.failure: Workers set out to raise a watchtower and earthworks, but the fortifications weren't finished.
fortify-hex.criticalFailure: Workers set out to raise a watchtower and earthworks, and the half-built works collapsed in the rain.

muster-troops.criticalSuccess: The levies were called up, drilled and marched where folks could see. They mustered in fine order, proud and ready, and the crowds cheered them through every village.
muster-troops.success: The levies were called up, drilled and marched where folks could see. The troops mustered and made a good show.
muster-troops.failure: The levies were called up, but the muster was half-hearted. Too few came, and those who did dragged their feet.
muster-troops.criticalFailure: The levies were called up, and the muster turned into a brawl between rival villages' men.

signature-ekundayo.criticalSuccess: Ekundayo led a hunt through the realm's wild lands for meat, hides and trade goods. It was a triumph, and the realm's stores are full to the rafters.
signature-ekundayo.success: Ekundayo led a hunt through the realm's wild lands for meat, hides and trade goods, and came back with a good haul.
signature-ekundayo.failure: Ekundayo led a hunt through the realm's wild lands, but the game was scarce, and the hunt came back light.
signature-ekundayo.criticalFailure: Ekundayo led a hunt through the realm's wild lands, and it went wrong out in the wild. The party came back hurt and empty-handed.

signature-jubilost.criticalSuccess: Jubilost went through the ledgers looking for money the realm didn't know it was owed. He found a hidden fortune, and he's been insufferable about it ever since.
signature-jubilost.success: Jubilost went through the ledgers looking for money the realm was owed, and he found some.
signature-jubilost.failure: Jubilost went through the ledgers looking for money the realm was owed, but found little worth the trouble.
signature-jubilost.criticalFailure: Jubilost went through the ledgers looking for money the realm was owed, and his digging upset people who'd rather the books stayed closed.

signature-linzi.criticalSuccess: Linzi wrote up the leaders' latest deeds and made sure everyone heard about them. Her tale is on every tongue, and it gets better each time it's told.
signature-linzi.success: Linzi wrote up the leaders' latest deeds and spread the word, and the story is doing nicely.
signature-linzi.failure: Linzi wrote up the leaders' latest deeds, but the story didn't catch on.
signature-linzi.criticalFailure: Linzi wrote up the leaders' latest deeds, and the story got garbled in the retelling into something embarrassing.

signature-nok-nok.criticalSuccess: Nok-Nok went looking for monsters who'd rather work for the realm than against it. He came back with eager recruits who scare the realm's enemies even more than its friends.
signature-nok-nok.success: Nok-Nok went looking for monsters who'd rather work for the realm, and he found a few willing ones.
signature-nok-nok.failure: Nok-Nok went looking for monsters who'd rather work for the realm, and came back alone and sulking.
signature-nok-nok.criticalFailure: Nok-Nok went looking for monsters who'd rather work for the realm, and the recruits he brought back are causing more trouble than they're worth.

signature-tristian.criticalSuccess: Tristian prepared wards and remedies against whatever might come next. They're ready for anything, and folks feel safer knowing it.
signature-tristian.success: Tristian prepared wards and remedies against whatever might come next, and his preparations are made.
signature-tristian.failure: Tristian prepared wards and remedies against what might come, but his preparations fell short.
signature-tristian.criticalFailure: Tristian prepared wards and remedies against what might come, and the work went wrong. He's crushed about it.

signature-valerie.criticalSuccess: Valerie drilled the realm's soldiers until they moved as one body. She's almost satisfied, which for Valerie is high praise.
signature-valerie.success: Valerie drilled the realm's soldiers hard, and the troops are sharper for it.
signature-valerie.failure: Valerie drilled the realm's soldiers, but the drills didn't take.
signature-valerie.criticalFailure: Valerie drilled the realm's soldiers too hard, and the drills ended in injuries and bad blood.

signature-harrim.criticalSuccess: Harrim preached doom in the streets, and somehow every heart that heard him was lifted. Folks are walking taller for having faced the worst.
signature-harrim.success: Harrim preached doom in the streets, and his gloomy sermons found an oddly cheerful audience.
signature-harrim.failure: Harrim preached doom in the streets, but he preached to an empty square.
signature-harrim.criticalFailure: Harrim preached doom in the streets, and his sermons frightened folks badly.

signature-jaethal.criticalSuccess: Jaethal threw a feast at the treasury's expense that nobody will forget. It's the stuff of legend, and everyone who was there is proud to say so.
signature-jaethal.success: Jaethal threw a feast at the treasury's expense, and it was a fine night.
signature-jaethal.failure: Jaethal threw a feast at the treasury's expense, and it was extravagant and dull.
signature-jaethal.criticalFailure: Jaethal threw a feast at the treasury's expense, and it went too far. The scandal followed.

signature-kalikke.criticalSuccess: Kalikke sat down with every report on the realm's troubles and made a plan. It's a masterpiece, with a careful answer to every one.
signature-kalikke.success: Kalikke sat down with every report on the realm's troubles and made a sound plan.
signature-kalikke.failure: Kalikke sat down with every report on the realm's troubles and made a plan, but it misses something.
signature-kalikke.criticalFailure: Kalikke sat down with every report on the realm's troubles and made a plan, and it backfired.

signature-kanerah.criticalSuccess: Kanerah spread word of a triumph that never quite happened. It's believed everywhere, and spirits are soaring.
signature-kanerah.success: Kanerah spread word of a triumph that never quite happened, and the story is spreading.
signature-kanerah.failure: Kanerah spread word of a triumph that never quite happened, but nobody quite believed it.
signature-kanerah.criticalFailure: Kanerah spread word of a triumph that never quite happened, and the lie was exposed.

signature-regongar.criticalSuccess: Regongar marched the troops through the worst parts of town. The streets were cowed, and they've stayed quiet since.
signature-regongar.success: Regongar marched the troops through the worst parts of town, and the show of force worked.
signature-regongar.failure: Regongar marched the troops through the worst parts of town, but it did little.
signature-regongar.criticalFailure: Regongar marched the troops through the worst parts of town, and the march turned ugly.
